history.summary: A 26-year-old 99-year leasehold 2BR in Bishan/Marymount (D20), 670m from CC16 Marymount MRT, listed at $1,453 psf — about 7% below the $1,559 URA median. Reasonable value with MRT access, but accelerating lease decay (~73 years left) and a moderate 28-txn series temper it.
history.rating_rationale: Listed PSF $1,453 is ~7% under the $1,559 URA median, a modest genuine discount, and the 969 sqft 2BR is a normal, efficient size. CC16 Marymount MRT at 670m gives Circle Line access to Bishan/MacRitchie amenities — a desirable, supply-constrained central-north location. The 6.2%/yr URA rate (28 txns, moderately reliable) reflects past strength. But this is a 99-year leasehold built in 2000 (~73 years remaining), so lease decay becomes a tangible resale headwind over the next 5-7 years, and D20 leasehold appreciation will lag freehold peers from here. Quantum $1.41M is liquid. A balanced hold, not a conviction buy.
